name: get-3-source-latest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,hashlib,re
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','source_get_guard.py','plans/get-3.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
a=hashlib.sha256(open('inputs/sources/2505.04000.pdf','rb').read()).hexdigest()
b=hashlib.sha256(open('sources/2505.04000-latest.pdf','rb').read()).hexdigest()
print('frozen',a); print('latest',b,'identical',a==b)
x=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/2505.04000-latest.pdf','derived/source-latest.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60); print(x.returncode,x.stderr)
t=open('derived/source-latest.txt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
print(len(t))
m=re.search(r'arXiv:\S+\s+\[math\.CO\]\s+[^\n]*',t); print(m.group(0) if m else 'no stamp')
for k in ['Conjecture 4.1','if one could','good if','typical']:
    for mm in re.finditer(re.escape(k),t):
        s=t[max(0,mm.start()-200):mm.end()+300]
        print('---',k); print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s))
